create.name: Erin Rose Ward
create.bio:
Erin Rose Ward teaches yoga, meditation, breathwork and free-form dance from her home in Ojai, California. Her yoga path began with a teacher training at Kripalu in 2012, and she went on to teach for more than a decade in New York and Los Angeles, including for the online movement platform The Class. Her studies have taken in Tantra yoga, Tibetan Buddhism and mystic Christianity, and she names Kevin Courtney of INSIGHT, 360 Emergence co-founder Kate Shela and Lena George among her mentors. She has spoken openly about how finding yoga in her twenties helped her through a hard period, and that experience shapes her steady, warm style of teaching.

Her classes centre on the body as a place of refuge and on the heart's capacity to hold whatever life brings. Each week she leads yoga in Ojai and The 360 Emergence, a guided, music-led dance practice, in Topanga, with monthly sessions in West Los Angeles. Online she runs The Refuge, an eight-week circle for women built around embodiment, wisdom teaching and council, and with her husband Andrew Griffes she hosts evenings for couples. She also mentors students one to one and leads weekend retreats at Kripalu.

courses.title: Cultivate Your Energy: Embodied Practices to Become a Lighthouse
courses.description: A long weekend at Kripalu in the Berkshires built around four practices: The 360 Emergence free-form dance, Tantric-style meditation that moves prana through the body, expressive breathwork and yoga nidra, with some yoga asana. It is meant for anyone who wants time in community to steady themselves and feel freer in their body.

courses.title: The Refuge
courses.description: A seasonal eight-week online circle for women, meeting live on Zoom for ninety minutes each week. Each week takes one theme, from breath and voice to play and purpose, with somatic practices between sessions, a private community space and lasting access to the recordings.

courses.title: Weekly Classes in Ojai, Topanga and Los Angeles
courses.description: Her regular in-person classes: yoga on Tuesday mornings in Ojai, The 360 Emergence dance on Wednesday evenings in Topanga, and monthly dance sessions in Ojai and West Los Angeles. Booking is through the events page.

courses.title: DATE NIGHT: An Evening for Couples
courses.description: A two-hour evening for couples in Ojai, hosted with her husband Andrew Griffes. Guided movement and connection exercises invite partners to turn towards each other and meet other couples on a similar path.
